metadata.description: An index of Claude Code plugins: delegation, focus, cache-status, guard and change-ledger, each in its own repository

plugins.name: cache-status
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter above the prompt, built on prompt-cache-control: read / wrote / new tokens per request, a live countdown, why the cache missed, and pop-ups before it lapses; plus what a re-ingest costs in your 5-hour window, what the cache saved today, Keep warm, Start fresh (clear and send a handoff brief, or copy it for a new chat), and a /cache pane with a per-turn table and history

plugins.name: focus
plugins.description: next-steps' suggested prompts above the prompt (press a number to draft one), explain buttons after a long reply (simpler, example, where it fits), time on task, today's wins and parked thoughts; a Focus pane with the plan, the next action, parked thoughts and a recap; bundles the i-have-adhd writing rules

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Everything for delegating coding work: Codex, agy and Claude worker skills; /delegate, /explore, /delegate-setup and /delegations; the official Codex plugin's commands bundled as /codex-* with matching /agy-* commands; a measured delegation policy that refuses tasks too small to be worth it; a confirmation before any run on the scarce Sol model; and a live view of running jobs and what they cost

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Stops a push made with the wrong GitHub account, and asks before a command that deletes folders, drops databases or rewrites git history, showing what it would remove

plugins.name: change-ledger
plugins.description: A pane listing every file Claude changed this session, grouped by who owns it, each with the request that caused it, and a button that copies the list as a standup note
